name: Design Handoff & Fidelity
description: Design Handoff & Fidelity standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DESIGN applies.

rules.title: Treat approved design artifacts as implementation input
rules.detail: Screens/components must reference the approved design/version and documented functional requirements; deviations require explicit rationale.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat approved design artifacts as implementation input.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat approved design artifacts as implementation input.

rules.title: Capture responsive, state and interaction variants
rules.detail: Design handoff includes key breakpoints, loading/empty/error/disabled states and interaction behavior, not only a success-state screenshot.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Capture responsive, state and interaction variants.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Capture responsive, state and interaction variants.

rules.title: Specify reusable tokens and components instead of one-off values
rules.detail: Colors, typography, spacing, radius and shared controls should map to the design system where one exists.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Specify reusable tokens and components instead of one-off values.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Specify reusable tokens and components instead of one-off values.

rules.title: Resolve ambiguous behavior before implementation completion
rules.detail: Missing interactions, copy, validation, overflow and edge cases are recorded as questions/decisions rather than guessed silently.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Resolve ambiguous behavior before implementation completion.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Resolve ambiguous behavior before implementation completion.

rules.title: Verify implementation fidelity at target viewports/devices
rules.detail: Review layout, hierarchy, typography, states and interaction against design using representative content.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Verify implementation fidelity at target viewports/devices.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Verify implementation fidelity at target viewports/devices.

rules.title: Allow platform conventions when documented
rules.detail: Design fidelity does not override accessibility, native interaction or technical constraints without an explicit product/design decision.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Allow platform conventions when documented.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Allow platform conventions when documented.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DESIGN applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Design Handoff & Fidelity to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Design Handoff & Fidelity is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Design Handoff & Fidelity failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
